name: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana (Urban)
description: Credit-linked subsidy and affordable housing support for urban poor/EWS/LIG/MIG to own a pucca house.
eligibility: Urban households in EWS/LIG/MIG categories with no pucca house; income and property criteria apply.
benefits: Interest subsidy on home loan (CLSS) and support for house construction.
application_mode: Online (pmaymis.gov.in) and via urban local bodies
application_steps: Enter Aadhaar, income, bank, property details.
processing_time: Verification and sanction per state/ULB cycle.
office_locator_info: Urban Local Bodies / State Nodal Agencies.

faq.a: EWS/LIG/MIG urban households without a pucca house, meeting income limits.

ai_summary: PMAY-U gives urban EWS/LIG/MIG households interest subsidy and support to build/buy a pucca house.
ai_explanation: PMAY-U aims 'Housing for All' in urban areas via Credit Linked Subsidy (CLSS) and direct construction support. Eligible households without a pucca house apply online or via ULBs; subsidy is credited to the loan account.
common_questions: How do I apply for PMAY subsidy?
suggested_followups: What are the PMAY-U income limits?
How is the CLSS subsidy calculated?
